title: 第19章 身无彩凤双飞翼心有灵犀一点通第20章 百倍奖励地阶功法
slug: 反派不朽帝族族人竟都是老六
content_zh:
………………
男子速度很快。
不一会就来到了萧家府邸。
房间内。
“什么，你是说江尘那家伙出来了，现在又去天香楼了？”
“是的少爷！”
萧云：“好，太好了。”
“等了这么多天那家伙终于出来了，这次我看还有谁能救你。”
说到这里时。
萧云眼眸中露出了一抹寒芒。
随后再次开口：“你快速去通知一下白家三少爷，告诉他可以开始行动了。”
“是，少爷！”
哈哈哈～
随着男子离去，萧云口中发出了一阵猖狂的大笑声，脸上满是得意之色。
沉声道：“只要把江尘解决掉，再去处理江宇那个废物，整个江家肯定会大乱。
“到时我再联合白鸿飞一起出手，肯定能从中获得不少的利益，这样一来，父亲和大哥一定会对我刮目相看的。”
提到自己大哥时。
萧云眼眸中满是崇拜之色。
他大哥名萧风，修炼天赋十分出众，以前还有个江宇能压他一头。
可自从江宇修炼天赋出问题后，萧风自然而然成为了神风城第一修炼天才。

不过。
现在云惜雪又异军突起。
颇有一副与萧风并驾齐驱的姿态。
虽然如此。
萧云对自己的大哥依旧充满自信。
……
另一边。
江尘并没有直接走向天香阁，而是直接避开了众人，从上次的小道走了上去。
一路前行。
江尘很快就来到了那个阁楼前，看着窗户前微红的烛光，他轻轻扣动了房门。
踏踏踏～
咯吱～
随着一阵脚步声传来，房门很快就被人给打开了，开门之人正是小灵。
当她看清来者是江尘后。
快速侧开了身子。
content_en:
………………
Men are fast.
After a while, they arrived at the Xiao family's residence.
inside the room.
"What, you mean that Jiang Chen guy came out and is now going to Tianxiang Tower again?"
"Yes, Master!"
Xiao Yun: "Okay, great."
"The guy who has been waiting for so many days has finally come out. Let's see who else can save you this time."
When it comes to this.
There was a hint of coldness in Xiao Yun's eyes.
Then he spoke again: "Quickly inform the third young master of the Bai family and tell him that he can start taking action."
"Yes, Master!"
Hahaha~
As the man left, Xiao Yun let out a burst of wild laughter, with a proud look on his face.
He said in a deep voice: "As long as Jiang Chen is dealt with and then Jiang Yu is dealt with, the entire Jiang family will definitely be in chaos.
"When the time comes, I will join forces with Bai Hongfei and we will definitely get a lot of benefits from it. In this way, my father and eldest brother will definitely look at me with admiration. "
When talking about his eldest brother.
Xiao Yun's eyes were full of admiration.
His eldest brother's name is Xiao Feng, and his talent in cultivation is very outstanding. There used to be Jiang Yu who could beat him.
But since Jiang Yu's cultivation talent went wrong, Xiao Feng naturally became the number one cultivation genius in Kamikaze City.
However.
Now Yun Xixue has suddenly emerged again.
He has a posture of keeping pace with Xiao Feng.
Even so.
Xiao Yun is still full of confidence in his eldest brother.
…
other side.
Jiang Chen did not go directly to Tianxiang Pavilion, but directly avoided everyone and walked up the trail from last time.
Keep going.
Jiang Chen quickly arrived at the attic. Looking at the reddish candlelight in front of the window, he gently opened the door.
Tap tap tap~
Creak~
Following the sound of footsteps, the door was quickly opened, and the person who opened the door was Xiao Ling.
When she saw clearly that the person coming was Jiang Chen.
Quickly turned away.
